subject: Architecture
title: Mycelium: Building with Mushroom Roots
description: Learn Mycelium: Building with Mushroom Roots in one minute.

hook.text: Mushroom roots can be grown into building blocks in just five days — no kiln, no factory needed.

buildup.text: Mycelium grows through agricultural waste, binding it into solid panels that insulate and resist fire.

discovery.text: At the end of a building's life, mycelium blocks can be composted — they return to soil in weeks.

twist.text: The MoMA PS1 gallery displayed a tower of mycelium bricks — grown, exhibited, and composted in one summer.

climax.text: Companies like Ecovative are scaling mycelium production for packaging, insulation, and structural panels.

punchline.text: Grow your walls. Compost them when done. Repeat forever.

quiz.question: How long does it take to grow mycelium building blocks?
